4.2.rationale: The original Indonesian text contains prevention education content, but the judge relied on general principles/objectives rather than the explicit prevention-education clause. Specifically, Pasal 29 ayat (1) huruf b states the government will “melakukan pendidikan tentang nilai-nilai anti kekerasan terhadap perempuan” (conduct education on anti-violence values against women). That is the strongest available evidence in the retrieved passages for an education-based prevention approach. However, the indicator is specifically “Gender equality education”; the retrieved text does not clearly say education on “kesetaraan gender” (gender equality) itself—only anti-violence education and general principles of gender equality (Pasal 2). The judge’s leap from ‘principle/objective of gender equality’ to ‘education about gender equality’ is not supported by the Indonesian wording. So the pipeline’s “Yes” is due to judge over-inference, not translation or retrieval.
